name: ChatGPT
summary: An all-purpose AI assistant for everyday tasks.
description: Ask questions, brainstorm, summarize text and work through ideas with a conversational AI assistant.
freeNote: Free usage is subject to changing message, feature and tool limits.

name: Claude
summary: Work through writing and analytical tasks.
description: A general-purpose AI assistant for drafting, reasoning, planning and long-form document work.
freeNote: An ongoing $0 plan exists, with limited usage.

name: DeepSeek Chat
summary: Ask questions and explore reasoning for free.
description: A web-based AI chatbot for research, writing and problem solving.
freeNote: The provider describes its consumer app as free; availability and usage policies may change.

name: GitHub Copilot Free
summary: AI coding suggestions inside supported editors.
description: Coding assistance for writing, completing and understanding software in a developer workflow.
freeNote: Free plan includes 2,000 completions per month; other AI features have limits.

name: Canva
summary: Create graphics, social posts and presentations.
description: A visual-design editor with templates and limited AI-powered creation features on its free plan.
freeNote: The Free plan includes limited AI use; some assets and premium features are paid.

name: ElevenLabs
summary: Generate speech and experiment with voice tools.
description: Text-to-speech, speech-to-text and related creative audio features available through a limited free plan.
freeNote: Free plan includes 10,000 credits monthly; commercial rights vary by plan.

name: Gamma
summary: Make slide decks and visual documents with AI.
description: Create quick presentations, documents and lightweight visual narratives from prompts.
freeNote: Free plan offers signup credits; ongoing AI generation may require more credits.

name: Runway
summary: Experiment with AI-assisted video creation.
description: A creative environment for generative video and image workflows.
freeNote: Free account includes one-time credits; the allowance does not replenish.

name: Suno
summary: Create AI-generated songs from ideas.
description: Compose demo songs and explore music generation without an upfront subscription.
freeNote: Free credits replenish daily, but free outputs do not include commercial-use rights.

name: Lovable
summary: Describe an app and start building it with AI.
description: A prompt-based app builder for early web application prototypes and experiments.
freeNote: Limited daily build credits and other free quotas; check current plan terms.

name: Ollama
summary: Run models directly on your computer.
description: Download compatible language models and execute inference locally without paying a cloud inference provider.
freeNote: Local model execution can be free; compute, storage and optional cloud features may cost extra.

name: Jan
summary: Desktop assistant for running local AI models.
description: Use an offline-first chat application to run compatible local AI models on supported computers.
freeNote: Open source; local performance and model sizes depend on device hardware.

name: Google Gemini
summary: Google’s assistant for questions and content.
description: Explore search-oriented questions, planning and drafting with Google’s conversational assistant.
freeNote: Check current feature and usage limits in your location.

name: Perplexity
summary: Research questions with source-linked answers.
description: Search and explore topics using answer-focused AI with citations and follow-up prompts.
freeNote: Advanced searches and features may be limited.

name: Microsoft Copilot
summary: A general assistant integrated with Microsoft tools.
description: Get conversational assistance with writing, search and everyday tasks.
freeNote: Check regional eligibility and feature limits.

name: Mistral Le Chat
summary: A versatile chat assistant from Mistral AI.
description: Chat, write and explore ideas using models offered by Mistral.
freeNote: Check free-account feature limits and availability.

name: Hugging Face Spaces
summary: Discover community AI demos and experiments.
description: Try public demos for language, images, speech and other machine-learning tasks.
freeNote: Individual Spaces have different limits and may be unavailable.

name: Google AI Studio
summary: Prototype with Gemini models and prompts.
description: Experiment with model prompts, outputs and basic application patterns in a developer interface.
freeNote: Free-tier quota and regional restrictions vary by model and usage.

name: Cursor
summary: Code editor with AI assistance.
description: An AI-oriented development environment for editing, reading and debugging code.
freeNote: Check current free-plan limits and model availability.

name: Windsurf
summary: AI-assisted developer workspace.
description: An editor experience designed to help developers code and navigate projects.
freeNote: Check account usage and advanced-feature caps.

name: Replit
summary: Create and host app prototypes in a browser.
description: Build applications through a web development environment with AI-powered capabilities.
freeNote: Cloud resources, publishing and agent usage can be limited or paid.

name: Bolt
summary: Prompt-to-app web prototyping.
description: Generate and refine website or app code from plain-language instructions.
freeNote: Free generation quotas and deployment options may change.

name: v0
summary: Generate user interfaces with prompts.
description: Quickly prototype UI layouts and components from natural-language requests.
freeNote: Check free monthly credits and publishing limits.

name: Leonardo AI
summary: Create concept art and visual assets.
description: Explore text-to-image creation, concept sketches and art workflows.
freeNote: Token quotas and output rights may differ by tier.

name: Ideogram
summary: Generate artwork and text-rich images.
description: Generate illustrative graphics, lettering and creative visual concepts.
freeNote: Free generations, image visibility and features may be limited.

name: Adobe Express
summary: Design quick visual content with templates.
description: Create social posts and graphics with layout tools and some AI-assisted features.
freeNote: Check current generative-credit allowance and premium asset restrictions.

name: Photopea
summary: Edit photos in a browser.
description: A browser photo editor useful alongside AI generation tools; not every feature is AI-based.
freeNote: Ad-supported editing; confirm any AI-specific feature availability.

name: remove.bg
summary: Remove image backgrounds.
description: Background removal for photos and product images.
freeNote: Free exports may have resolution or quantity limits.

name: Pika
summary: Generate short creative video clips.
description: Explore AI video and motion creation from visual or text prompts.
freeNote: Generation credits and export conditions may be limited.

name: CapCut
summary: Edit videos and automate selected creator tasks.
description: Video editing with captions, templates and selected AI-assisted creative features.
freeNote: Some AI effects and exports may require a paid plan.

name: Descript
summary: Edit recordings through transcripts.
description: An audio and video workflow using transcription and text-based editing.
freeNote: Free transcription and media processing limits apply.

name: Adobe Podcast
summary: Clean up and enhance speech recordings.
description: Voice recording and sound enhancement workflows for spoken audio.
freeNote: Feature eligibility and processing limits may change.

name: OpenAI Whisper
summary: Run speech recognition locally.
description: An open-source automatic speech recognition model that developers can run with their own computing resources.
freeNote: Model execution is open source; local compute or cloud infrastructure is your responsibility.

name: Grammarly
summary: Check and improve everyday writing.
description: Writing assistance for grammar, tone, clarity and professional communication.
freeNote: Advanced rewriting and generative assistance may be limited.

name: QuillBot
summary: Rephrase and polish written material.
description: Paraphrasing and editing assistance for drafts, study notes and communications.
freeNote: Free rewriting modes and usage are limited.

name: DeepL
summary: Translate and refine multilingual text.
description: Translation and writing assistance for documents and messages.
freeNote: Document size and advanced features may be limited.

name: NotebookLM
summary: Explore your own sources with AI.
description: Create grounded summaries and notes from documents and sources you provide.
freeNote: Notebook and usage limits vary by account tier.

name: Napkin AI
summary: Turn ideas into business visuals.
description: Create diagrams and visual explainers from text for presentations and reports.
freeNote: Check generation and export restrictions.

name: Google Colab
summary: Run Python notebooks in the cloud.
description: Analyze data and experiment with machine-learning workflows in hosted notebooks.
freeNote: Free compute resources and availability are limited; not itself an AI assistant.

name: Kaggle Notebooks
summary: Practice data science with public datasets.
description: Use datasets and hosted notebooks to learn and experiment with machine learning.
freeNote: Compute quotas, hardware access and notebook policies apply.

name: Orange Data Mining
summary: Explore data without extensive coding.
description: A visual workflow tool for data mining and selected machine learning applications.
freeNote: Open source desktop software; processing runs on your computer.

name: KNIME Analytics Platform
summary: Build reproducible analytics workflows.
description: A visual data-processing and machine-learning workspace for structured workflows.
freeNote: Local analytics platform; enterprise features may be separate.

name: n8n Self Hosted
summary: Automate tasks on your infrastructure.
description: Connect services with a visual workflow tool that you can self-host where license terms permit.
freeNote: Self-hosting needs infrastructure; license has use restrictions and is not OSI open source.

name: Activepieces
summary: Build no-code workflow automations.
description: Connect tools and build event-triggered automations with cloud or self-hosted options.
freeNote: Cloud usage and integration limits vary; self-hosting incurs infrastructure costs.

name: Make
summary: Connect applications in a visual workflow.
description: Create scenarios that pass data between services and reduce manual work.
freeNote: The free plan limits operations and execution frequency.

name: Zapier
summary: Automate tasks between online services.
description: Connect business apps through triggers and actions.
freeNote: Tasks, multi-step workflows and premium integrations have restrictions.

name: LM Studio
summary: Experiment with language models locally.
description: Download and chat with compatible models from a desktop environment.
freeNote: The application is free to use locally, but check its license; not all code is open source.

name: Aider
summary: Edit code with an AI pair programmer in terminal.
description: A terminal-based programming assistant that integrates with Git and model providers.
freeNote: Software is open source; hosted model APIs may still charge.

name: Open WebUI
summary: Self-host a chat interface for AI models.
description: A customizable interface for chatting with self-hosted and connected model backends.
freeNote: Hosting and optional model APIs may involve costs.

name: Hugging Face Transformers
summary: Build and run open model workflows.
description: A software library for working with a wide range of machine-learning models.
freeNote: Free library; model licences, hardware and hosted services vary.

name: Gradio
summary: Turn Python model functions into web demos.
description: A Python library for quickly making interfaces around AI and data applications.
freeNote: Open source; deployment or external inference can have separate costs.

name: Figma
summary: Design, inspect and prototype user interfaces collaboratively.
description: Use Figma Design and FigJam to turn requirements into wireframes, clickable prototypes and collaborative journey maps.
freeNote: Starter is free with product and team-file restrictions; some advanced publishing, Dev Mode and AI features require paid access.

name: Penpot
summary: Open-source UI design and prototyping with a free cloud plan.
description: Collaborate on product interface design, prototypes and design systems in a tool built for designers and developers.
freeNote: Professional cloud plan listed at $0 with storage/team limitations; self-hosting is open source but requires infrastructure.

name: diagrams.net (draw.io)
summary: Create BPMN, flowcharts, UML and database diagrams for free.
description: Build business-process diagrams, architecture maps, ER models and simple user journeys in an online diagram editor.
freeNote: The browser diagram editor is free; connected third-party storage may have separate terms.

name: Mermaid Live Editor
summary: Generate process flows and charts from editable text diagrams.
description: Describe a sequence, process or system architecture in Mermaid syntax, preview it and iterate in a browser.
freeNote: The open-source syntax and live editor are available without an account. Paid hosted Mermaid services are separate.

name: Excalidraw
summary: Sketch collaborative workflows and simple wireframes on a free canvas.
description: Draw product ideas, explain processes and sketch rough interfaces with a minimalist browser whiteboard.
freeNote: The base open-source whiteboard is free and does not require an account; Excalidraw Plus has separate paid features.

name: Flowise
summary: Build self-hosted AI agents and LLM workflows visually.
description: Use visual Chatflow and Agentflow builders to prototype chatbots, RAG, approvals and multi-step AI workflows.
freeNote: Self-hosted Apache-2.0 source is available; hosting resources and any third-party model API calls may cost extra.

name: Docling
summary: Convert complex PDFs and Office documents into structured AI-ready content.
description: Parse tables, layouts and text from PDFs, documents and spreadsheets, exporting Markdown or JSON for research and retrieval.
freeNote: MIT-licensed Python software runs locally; optional cloud compute or external model services are separate costs.

name: Langflow
summary: Design, test and deploy LLM applications with a visual flow editor.
description: Build reusable flows using model, tool and data components, then expose them as APIs for application development.
freeNote: Self-hosted source is available, but cloud infrastructure and model-provider API usage can incur charges.

name: Browser Use
summary: Develop browser-operating AI agents with an open-source Python library.
description: Create task-driven browser automation using a local open-source agent library and a compatible LLM provider.
freeNote: The open-source library is free; hosted Browser Use Cloud, browsers, proxy services, and external AI models may be billed separately.

name: Browser Harness
summary: Connect coding agents to your existing Chrome browser.
description: Use an open-source Chrome DevTools harness to let supported coding agents navigate, inspect and operate the real browser.
freeNote: MIT-licensed harness is free; the coding agent or model powering it may require separate access or paid usage.
